items.title: Chuck Mancuso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 10, 2013
items.q: they had Wynonie Harris Going Wild

ctx.x: And it said “We sell in all three fields: Hillbilly, Pops and Sepia.” And it’s so informative to see that language.

Yeah. Because Cincinnati was, like a border town. They had the black part of town on one side, and they had the white part, so you had Moon Mulligan and Hank Penny and his Radio Cowboys, and then they had Wynonie Harris Going Wild. And oh my God.

And here’s a statement you have regarding Benny Goodman. “That Goodman was white and more palatable to the dominant white pop audience should be of little surprise. Even while making a radical shift popular culture seizes upon that which is most accommodating and secure.”
